# Latine Mayfair

> Latine is a French–Latin American restaurant at 10–11 Lancashire Court, Mayfair, London W1S 1EY, in the cobbled mews between Brook Street and New Bond Street. It has a terrace, a marble crudo bar, a dining room, the La Candela cocktail lounge and El Cielo, a private dining room. This file is the restaurant's own summary of key facts.

## Key facts
- Name: Latine Mayfair (also written Latine)
- Cuisine: French technique with Latin American flavours; ceviche, tiradito, oysters and seafood, grilled fish and meat
- Address: 10–11 Lancashire Court, Mayfair, London W1S 1EY, United Kingdom
- Nearest station: Bond Street
- Opening hours: Monday to Saturday, 12pm to midnight. Closed Sunday
- Phone: +44 20 3887 3126
- Email: contact@latinemayfair.com
- Reservations: https://www.opentable.co.uk/r/latine-mayfair-reservations-london (OpenTable) or by phone
- Website: https://latinemayfair.com/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/latinemayfair
- Executive Chef: Francisco Lafee. General Manager: Cyril Blaret
- Dress code: no strict dress code; smart casual is usual. No sportswear, beachwear or flip-flops
- Cancellations: at least 24 hours' notice is requested

## Spaces
- Terrace: outdoor tables in Lancashire Court
- The Restaurant and crudo bar (ground floor): lunch and dinner; oysters, ceviche and crudo prepared at a marble bar
- La Candela (first floor): cocktail lounge that becomes livelier later in the evening, with DJs
- El Cielo (second floor): private dining room for up to 20 guests seated or more than 40 standing, with tailored menus, available for lunch and dinner

## Menus and prices
- À la carte crudo: Tiradito de daurade (sea bream sashimi, coconut leche de tigre, roasted avocado, mint, £21); Ceviche de loup de mer (sea bass ceviche, passion fruit leche de tigre, popcorn, £23); Tiradito de hamachi (hamachi sashimi, pineapple aguachile, sweetcorn blinis, £25); Ceviche de crevettes rouges (red prawn ceviche, mango & yuzu leche de tigre, plantain chips, £35); Steak tartare (hand-cut steak tartare, truffle mayonnaise & crisp potato pavé, £24)
- À la carte starters: Escargots (baked snails, chimichurri butter, £22); Tacos de bœuf bourguignon (bœuf Bourguignon stew, pickled pineapple, sweet potato purée, £17); Croquettes de canard (duck croquettes, guava chipotle chutney, £12); Moules latine (cornish mussels, Latine marinière, fries, £22); Pão de queijo (brazilian cheese bread, Camembert filling, £12)
- À la carte mains: Magret de canard (pan-fried duck magret, confit potimarron, guava sauce, £35); Calamars grillés (grilled squid, ají panca chilli, sweetcorn purée, £33); Ribeye (chargrilled ribeye, chimichurri Béarnaise, £130); Côtelettes d’agneau (marinated lamb cutlets, plantain ravioli, Andean jus, £48); Filet de bœuf (chargrilled beef fillet, Périgord sauce, dark chocolate, £52)
- Set lunch: Monday to Friday, 12 to 3pm; 2 courses £29, 3 courses £38
- Signature cocktails: Dolce Oscura, Noche de Reyes, Piment Doré, La Nube Blanca, Rio Enchanté, The Contraband
- Wine: around 136 wines, mainly from France (Champagne, Burgundy, Bordeaux, Loire, Rhône), Italy and South America (chiefly Argentina), with fine wines by the glass
- A discretionary 13.5% service charge is added to the bill
- Full menus with prices: https://latinemayfair.com/our-menu/

## Offers
- Champagne and oysters: a bottle of Champagne and a dozen oysters for £60. Thursday and Friday 5pm to 7pm, Saturday 2pm to 5pm

## Christmas 2026
- Christmas menu "Menu Gran Latine": £120 per person. Crudo: Hot prawn ceviche, Sea bass tiradito, Ceviche de chou-fleur rôti; Starter: Foie gras tostada, Latine chicken stew vol-au-vent, Lentil salad; Main: Beef filet, Turkey roulade, Butterflied sea bass, Cauliflower steak; Dessert: Chocolate fondant, Tarte tatin au plantain
- Private Christmas parties in El Cielo (20 seated, 40+ standing); larger tables in the restaurant on request
- Details and enquiries: https://latinemayfair.com/christmas/

## New Year
- New Year menu "Festive Menu Latine": £75 per person. Crudo: Tiradito de daurade, Ceviche de bar, Tiradito de thon, Steak tartare, Ceviche de chou-fleur rôti; Starter: Croquettes de canard, Tacos de bœuf bourguignon, Salade de burrata; Main course: Suprême de poulet, Poulpe grillé, Chou hispi grillé à la braise; Dessert: Crème brûlée, Chocolate fondant
- New Year menu "Festive Menu Latine": £120 per person. Crudo: Sea bass tiradito, Hot prawn ceviche, Ceviche de chou-fleur rôti; Starter: Foie gras tostada, Latine chicken stew vol-au-vent, Lentil salad; Main: Butterflied sea bass, Turkey roulade, Beef filet, Cauliflower steak; Dessert: Chocolate fondant, Tarte tatin au plantain
- Six oysters can be added to either menu for £26
- Details and enquiries: https://latinemayfair.com/new-year/
